justification: One shell line in an internal capture script plus a .gitattributes rule; no product code

pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a suburb that genuinely ends in CR does not exist; stripping one trailing CR is safe
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: applies to the next capture run

break_it.scenario: panel.tsv checked out with CRLF line endings on Windows
break_it.what_happens: every capture's address check fails and the run scores 0 of 0
break_it.how: run_captures.sh strips the trailing CR; .gitattributes keeps *.tsv LF
break_it.repro: bash scripts/page_integrity/run_captures.sh on a CRLF panel.tsv
